text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 31 units of indigotindisulfonate sodium 8 mg/mL 5 mL ampules, providing 7.1 days of supply at 4.4 units per day. Corvale General holds 64 units, providing 14.8 days at 4.3 units per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 10 units, providing 8.5 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows an earlier shortage of indigotindisulfonate sodium first posted on 2022-08-23, since resolved. The drug is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The product label for NDC 81284031505 names CENEXI (FEI 3007250542) as the registered plant for analysis, manufacture, and pack. FDA inspection 1245208 at that plant ended 2022-10-26 and was classified VAI — 64 days after FDA posted the shortage on 2022-08-23. Earlier inspections at the same plant include an OAI classification in 2015 (inspection 924508) and VAI classifications in 2012, 2016, and 2018.

Our position: No current FDA shortage listing exists. Inventory at Corvale East is below two weeks. Corvale General can spare units while maintaining a two-week buffer. Corvale Lakeside is not included in the transfer plan.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 units of 8 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
